At AstraZeneca, we pride ourselves on crafting a collaborative culture that champions knowledge-sharing, ambitious thinking and innovation – ultimately providing employees with the opportunity to work across teams, functions and even the globe.
 Recognizing the importance of individualized flexibility, our ways of working allow employees to balance personal and work commitments while ensuring we continue to build a strong culture of collaboration and teamwork by engaging face-to-face in our offices 3 days a week.
 Our dedication to sustainability is also central to our culture and part of what makes AstraZeneca a great place to work. We know the health of people, the planet and our business are interconnected which is why we’re taking ambitious action to address some of the biggest challenges of our time, from climate change to access to healthcare and disease prevention.
Reporting to the Senior Director, RWD Science, the role will collaborate with epidemiology, statistics, health economics, pharmacovigilance, and medical evidence teams to design and deliver observational studies and advanced analyses that support therapeutic-area strategies, product development, and business decision-making. The role has a global remit and is based within AstraZeneca’s global geographical footprint.
 Key Responsibilities
 RWD analysis and delivery:   Deliver and implement secondary data analyses using electronic health records, insurance claims, registries, and other observational data to address therapeutic-area evidence needs 
 Scientific and technical leadership: Provide expert guidance on observational study design, data-source selection, data-partner evaluation, statistical analysis plans, and best practices in RWD utilization.
 Assess the strengths, limitations, capabilities, and suitability of external RWD sources
 Cross-functional collaboration: Work with epidemiologists, statisticians, health economists, medical teams, and other stakeholders throughout the study execution.
 Mentor and coach data scientists and contribute to technical education, knowledge sharing, communities of practice, and continuous improvement across the RWDS organization.
 Maintain awareness of developments in RWD, causal inference, healthcare analytics, data standards, AI, and emerging analytical platforms, and assess their practical relevance to AZ evidence generation through external partnerships.
 Translate complex analytical findings, data limitations, and methodological trade-offs into clear insights and options for scientific and business partners.
 Lead or contribute to structured data feasibility and fit-for-purpose assessments that make data availability, quality, completeness, follow-up, endpoint capture, confounding, and key trade-offs visible to study teams. 
 Apply and advance appropriate statistical, epidemiological, machine-learning, and data-science methods for healthcare research, with methods selected according to the scientific question and data context.
 Develop, use, review, and promote standardized and reusable analytical assets, including code, code lists, functions, templates, documentation, and quality-control approaches, to improve consistency and reproducibility.
 Use artificial intelligence and automation as decision-support and productivity capabilities with appropriate human oversight, validation, documentation, and protection of patient-level data.
 Essential Qualifications and Experience
 Advanced degree: PhD or MSc in statistics, mathematics, data science, or a life-sciences discipline, combined with relevant industry experience.
 RWE expertise: Proven experience delivering real-world evidence or observational research, with familiarity in epidemiology, health economics, health-outcomes modelling, or related quantitative disciplines.
 Healthcare data: Hands-on experience working with EMR/EHR, disease-registry, and/or insurance-claims databases.
 Data standards: Knowledge of clinical data standards, medical terminologies, controlled vocabularies, and healthcare ontologies, including ICD-9/10 and SNOMED.
 Study delivery: Experience supporting pharmacoepidemiology studies, including the development and execution of Statistical Analysis Plans.
 Programming: Proficiency in SQL and R and/or Python.
 Leadership: Demonstrated ability to lead multidisciplinary data-science projects and translate scientific and business needs into actionable RWD programmes.
 Desirable Experience
 Experience in advanced visualization and visual analytics of healthcare data, applying RWD to pharmacovigilance, delivering solutions in a global organization, and developing long-term stakeholder and external-partner relationships.

Who we are 
 Recovering entrepreneur? Frustrated with bureaucracy? Want to write the roadmap, not inherit one? 
 We're hiring across multiple levels and verticals. The nice thing about growing 30%+ at ~$2B ARR is that we need great engineers everywhere, and we have the room to shape the role around the right person. You build like a founder. We give you the platform to do it at scale.
 About the role: 
 Samsara (NYSE: IOT) sits at the center of hardware, software, AI, and the physical world. The platform processes 25+ trillion data points annually from IoT sensors, cameras, and connected devices across thousands of organizations, and that dataset is compounding: it grew from 4 trillion to 25+ trillion in four years. We're still early in turning that data into the products that will define how physical operations run, and we're hiring the engineers who will build what comes next.
 We're approaching ~$2B ARR growing 30%+ year over year, with 96% of our largest customers on two or more products. The fastest-growing divisions at Samsara are tackling the hardest, most ambiguous problems at the company: building new products from scratch, applying AI and ML to massive real-world datasets, and shipping capabilities that change how organizations maintain equipment, manage fleets, and run day-to-day operations. Most of this work is zero-to-one, at billion-dollar scale.
 We're looking for software engineers who want to define what ships next. Leveling is broad and flexible: we're hiring from Senior through Staff+, across platform and product, and we're open to shaping scope around the right person's strengths and interests. That window won't stay open long.
 This role is remote and open to candidates residing in Canada. Relocation assistance will not be provided for this role. 
 You should apply if: 
 You want to impact the industries that run our world. The software you build will have real-world stakes: helping keep the lights on, getting food into grocery stores, keeping workers safe. What ships here isn't metrics on a dashboard. It shows up on the loading dock, the job site, and the dispatch floor.
 You want to build, not maintain. Samsara is in full growth mode. We're building new systems from scratch, not babysitting old ones. You'd own entire problem spaces end to end, with the autonomy to set direction from day one.
 You want to work where AI meets the physical world. Samsara has spent a decade building the largest proprietary dataset for physical operations. More connected assets generate more data, more data trains better models, better models drive more value, and more value wins more assets. The market and the opportunity here are what set us apart, not just the models.
 You believe customers are more than a number. Samsara engineers have a rare closeness to end users. You'll participate in customer interviews, collaborate with product managers and customer success, and use that context to build products that solve real problems operators face every day.
 You have the curiosity and drive to figure it out. We're looking for people who take pride in their work and get things done at all costs. The engineers who thrive here don't wait to be told what to build. They define it, ship it, and own the outcome. The rate-limiting step on our teams isn't tooling or process. It's ambition.
 In this role, you will: 
 Take ownership of technically complex, mission-critical areas and run with them. We want to point you in a direction and show up to the demo meeting impressed, not spend our weeks managing the details.
 Define and drive technical strategy for new products and platform capabilities, from backend services and APIs to the customer-facing UI.
 Design and ship full-stack features end to end. You'll work across backend, frontend, and potentially mobile to deliver AI-powered products that solve real operational problems.
 Partner with product, design, and customer-facing teams to translate ambiguous, real-world problems into clear technical plans and measurable outcomes.
 Build and scale the systems behind AI-driven products, including data ingestion, APIs, and the workflows that put intelligence into the hands of operators.
 Raise the bar for the engineers around you through code reviews, design reviews, technical mentorship, and by setting a standard for quality, velocity, and craft.
 Minimum requirements for the role: 
 Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
 8+ years of experience in software design and development, including building and operating production systems at scale.
 Strong full-stack fundamentals. You're comfortable working across backend services, APIs, and frontend (web or mobile) to ship complete products.
 Proficiency in modern languages and frameworks (Go, Python, TypeScript/JavaScript, React, or similar).
 Demonstrated experience leading cross-team or cross-org projects from inception through rollout, including managing ambiguity, driving alignment, and delivering measurable impact.
 Experience building AI-powered or data-driven products. You don't need to train models, but you know how to take AI capabilities and turn them into products customers love.
 Strong communication skills and the ability to translate between technical and non-technical stakeholders.
 A track record of building: zero-to-one products, systems you left in a meaningfully better place, or hard problems you refused to let stay unsolved.
 An ideal candidate also has: 
 Experience shipping AI-powered features in production, whether that's LLM-based products, agentic workflows, recommendation systems, or other customer-facing AI.
 Comfort with modern AI-augmented development workflows (Cursor, LLMs, etc.) to multiply your output and accelerate delivery.
 Background working with real-world operational data (telematics, sensor data, work orders, inspections) or a strong interest in learning the domain.
 A proven track record of mentoring senior engineers and influencing engineering culture, standards, and best practices beyond a single team.
 Side projects, open-source contributions, or other signals of curiosity and drive outside the scope of your day job.

Please note that base pay offered may vary depending on factors including your city of residence, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. This role is also eligible for an initial RSU grant with no vesting cliff, and ongoing refresh opportunities tied to performance, subject to plan terms and conditions. Learn more about our total rewards and benefits below. 
 Annual Base Salary
 $142,800 — $184,800 CAD 
 Total Rewards 
 At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. About Blair Health 
 Blair Health is a clinical infrastructure company closing the specialist gap. Today, someone with perimenopause, menopause, pelvic health, urology or nutrition concerns can see three primary care providers and a specialist and still leave without an answer. Blair changes that.
 Our platform gives generalist clinicians the tools, protocols and clinical support to deliver specialist-grade care across menopause and perimenopause, urology and pelvic health, and nutrition, with weight loss coming soon.
 To date, our focus has been women’s health. We believe all people should have access to specialist-level care, and we are opening our care to men, starting with weight management.
 The Role 
 We’re looking for a commercially minded Internal Medicine or Family Physician to join our clinical leadership team as the Canadian Medical Lead for our weight management vertical. The vertical’s clinical protocols have been developed by our obesity medicine specialist; you’ll provide medical oversight across Canada as we launch and scale, making sure those protocols are delivered safely, consistently and in line with current Canadian guidelines.
 You’ll report to our Chief Medical Officer, Dr. Lindsay Shirreff, and work closely with our obesity medicine specialist, Dr. Pooja Singhal, and our provider group. As Blair Health expands, the role will include involvement in our other verticals.
 Location: Canada, virtual or in person
 Commitment: Part-time, 1–2 days per week
 Reports to: Chief Medical Officer
 What You’ll Do 
 Lead medical oversight of the weight management vertical in Canada, ensuring our established protocols and care pathways are implemented and followed consistently across the provider group.
 Keep protocols current, working with our obesity medicine specialist to review and update them as Canadian guidelines and evidence evolve.
 Lead quality and safety oversight for the vertical, including case reviews, clinical KPI and quality monitoring, and adverse-event review.
 Act as the senior physician resource for our providers, receiving escalations through defined pathways and offering case review, advice and direct consultation where appropriate.
 Take part in clinical leadership meetings and contribute to decisions on clinical governance, provider support and the launch of new services.
 Lead or contribute to education rounds with the provider group.
 Contribute to other verticals as Blair Health expands, including oversight and escalation pathways as new services launch.
 How to Apply 
 Apply through this posting with your CV and a brief note on your weight management and clinical leadership experience.
 Blair Health is committed to equity, diversity, and inclusion. 
 Must Have 
 Licensure and good standing in at least one Canadian province, ideally Ontario
 FRCPC in Internal Medicine or CCFP
 Clinical experience in obesity and weight management, including pharmacotherapy
 CMPA coverage
 Experience or interest in clinical leadership, quality improvement or clinical governance
 Comfort supporting generalist clinicians in a protocol-driven, team-based model, virtually or in person
 Nice to Have 
 Licensure in additional provinces
 French fluency
 Compensation: competitive compensation
 Flexibility: a part-time commitment of 1–2 days per week, virtually or in person
 Leadership: a seat on the clinical leadership team of an early-stage company building clinical infrastructure that closes the specialist gap

As a Business Development Representative (BDR) at Cohere, you will drive revenue growth by identifying, qualifying, and nurturing high-potential leads for our enterprise AI solutions. You’ll act as the first point of contact for prospects, understanding their business needs and aligning them with Cohere’s products to solve complex challenges like natural language processing, AI integration, and scalable language models. You’ll also have the opportunity to sell cutting-edge IP, that is being newly productised, within your own book of business.

 - Proactively research and identify target accounts across region in industries such as finance, technology, manufacturing, healthcare, public sector, etc. using tools like LinkedIn Sales Navigator and CRM platforms to prioritise high-fit prospects.

 - Familiarity with CRM tools (e.g., Salesforce, HubSpot) and sales enablement platforms, with the ability to analyse data to optimize outreach strategies.

ROLE SUMMARY 
 Medical Information and Review (MIR) is a global customer-centric group focused on providing trusted and accurate medical information for Pfizer products to healthcare providers, patients, and caretakers, and collaborating with key stakeholders to deliver the Medical Review process for Medical and Promotional content, ensuring compliance with Pfizer policies and local requirements.
 Key expectations for this role include leading core MIR science-related activities for a designated portfolio by leveraging expertise with MIR science skills in ensuring the delivery of high quality medical and scientific information to healthcare professionals, patients, and external organizations, as well as serving as the MIR subject matter expert with Business Unit(s), Product/Category Team(s), and other platform functions in support of departmental and company objectives. The scope of responsibilities will include Local and Global elements. The Senior Manager, MIR Scientist may participate in or lead relatively complex projects/initiatives within the Medical Information and Review function for their market. Additionally, a MIR Scientist, Senior Manager is expected to actively contribute to, and lead, relatively complex projects/initiatives.
 Role Responsibilities 
 Core MIR Scientific Services 
 Subject matter expert for MIR on responsible product(s) and associated categories.
 Leads the medical to medical and medical to patient exchanges in response to unsolicited medical inquiries on Pfizer medicines and vaccines using expertise with MIR science skills in defining the research question, researching the relevant topics, evaluating the evidence, and synthesizing it to deliver high quality medical and scientific information
 Manages escalated (high complexity) unsolicited medical inquiries from HCPs in real time as required, facilitating direct scientific peer-to-peer customer interactions via phone or preferred channel, including developing custom responses when required.
 Reviews content generated by the Content Team ensuring accurate and fair balanced scientific content collections and/or custom responses for designated portfolio in accordance with MIR standards and prevailing regulations. Ensures the availability, accuracy, and maintenance of medical content on digital MIR, medical and other self-service platforms.
 Contributes to the development of MIR scientific response documents particularly during periods of approval/launch readiness
 Leads launch preparedness in MIR for applicable products/major indications from a scientific content perspective, including MIR Customer Experience Team readiness
 Lead the development and delivery of product training and resources for the MIR Customer Engagement contact center to ensure unsolicited medical questions are readily answered by the contact center.
 May be required to manage non-escalated MIR Contact Center unsolicited medical questions (phone and non-phone) as business needs shift
 Manages periodic label updates in collaboration with Content Team.
 Conducts reviews of medical content in accordance with relevant internal SOPs and external regulatory guidance, alerting project teams in a timely manner of any definite or potential deviations
 Supports review of medical content for products within assigned therapeutic area, as well as other products as needed.
 Ensures delivery of all required activities are within expected timelines 
 Purpose Blueprint Contributions 
 Applies expertise with MIR science, product/category & customer journeys to meaningfully contribute towards transforming MIR in support of Pfizer’s purpose.
 Analyzes customer insights to shape the strategy and development of Pfizer MIR scientific content & tools in support of product launches, market events and HCP & patient needs. Provides insights to Medical & Commercial teams to inform Go-To-Market plans.
 Exhibits broad knowledge of the customer journey to MIR and is the content strategist in ensuring relevant content is created, maintained, and pushed to customers preferred MIR channels (IVR, websites, contact center etc.) in a timely manner.
 Contributes to solidifying Pfizer’s position as an Industry AI leader and to advancing our MIR transformation priorities by adopting innovative technologies that will optimize organizational efficiency.
 Conceptualizes new content formats and collaborates with Medical content teams and/or vendors to deploy scientific content on Omnichannel platforms for use by Field Medical, HCPs and patients. 
 External & Internal Stakeholder Engagement 
 Drives awareness of MIR content and channels through partnerships centered around customeraccess with external and internal stakeholders.
 Establishes, maintains, and grows relationships with internal stakeholders to identify and communicate the value of MIR to the Pfizer business.
 Facilitates key scientific conventions/congresses participation as needed in meeting preparation activities, management of MI booths during congresses and post-congress involvement with cross-functional teams.
 Works collaboratively with Health Outcomes Research [HEOR] and Medical in the development and maintenance of formulary-related documents in support of improving access to state Medicaid and managed care formularies in the US
 Provides guidance for the appropriate use of scientific evidence by reviewing materials developed by external compendia (e.g., Medical Letter, MediSpan, treatment guidelines, etc.)
 Accountability & Leadership 
 Makes decisions on medical topics to be addressed by MIR content libraries for designated products, based on knowledge of product and customer needs
 Serves as final approver or reviewer for relevant local/global product scientific response documents
 Mentors, coaches, and trains new and existing colleagues.
 Leads issue resolution related to day-to-day work, proposes recommendations, and drives implementation of changes, new processes, etc.
 Supports innovative solutions at the local/global level to improve MIR processes and responses and to resolve problems based on comprehensive business knowledge.
 Actively participates or leads/co-leads Local and/or Global projects/initiatives that have an impact beyond the function and/or the country.
 Maintains compliance with local and global Standard Operating Procedures, Work Instructions, training requirements and local laws and regulations.
 Provides an MIR perspective on the development and revision of SOPs, Work Instructions, and local Job Aids as necessary.
 Supports audit and inspection preparation and readiness activities. 
 Leadership

 BS in Pharmacy, B.Pharm. Masters or PhD, PharmD, or MD.  Degrees from other medical disciplines also considered.

 Demonstrates excellent collaboration, interpersonal & relationship management skills with ability to influence and negotiate outcomes
 Ability to work in a virtual work environment
 Skilled at utilizing medical literature and drug information databases
 Proficient at critically evaluating literature and writing/summarizing clinical and scientific data
 Exhibits strong oral and written communication skills
 Demonstrates strong analytical skills
 Able to work in a fast-paced environment with competing priorities

 5 or more years of pharmaceutical Medical Information experience preferred
 Candidates with pertinent industry-related experience and/or post-graduate specialty/residency/fellowship and/or registration as a pharmacist are desirable
 Experience in working with MI systems used for information requests and content management, and digital communication, and omnichannel platforms highly desired

 PHYSICAL/MENTAL REQUIREMENTS

We’re hiring our first AEs at Pogo to help us scale our B2B enterprise business from $XM ARR to $XXM ARR. You'll own the full sales cycle from prospecting to expansion.

ABOUT YOU 👩‍🚀

 - Likely 3-10 years of sales experience, including selling to enterprise customers end-to-end

 - You're a hunter. You're energized by building pipeline from scratch and you don't wait for leads to come to you.

 - You're a strong communicator who can earn credibility quickly with senior stakeholders and translate a product demo into a compelling business case.

 - You're hands-on and resourceful. You do whatever it takes to get a deal across the line.

 - You take ownership of your number. You know where you stand at all times and you're always working the problem.

 - You're a fast learner who picks up new products, industries, and buyer personas quickly.

 - You use AI tools to work smarter and to do better research, better outreach, better prep.

 - You can tell stories with data.

 - You have sold insights or data analytics products

 - Help build the GTM motion from the ground up. You won’t just be joining a sales team - you’ll help define how we sell, who we sell to, and what great looks like as we scale.

 The Operations Enablement team builds the capabilities required to deliver fast, accurate, and high-quality servicing experiences for Affirm’s customers and merchants—while identifying opportunities to eliminate the need for them to contact us in the first place. Our work includes designing training and operational readiness strategies, standing up new servicing experiences, defining and measuring interaction quality, and ensuring agents can quickly access the information they need to resolve issues correctly.

We then build the learning programs, quality frameworks, knowledge systems, processes, and tools needed to close those gaps—while helping our Product and Engineering partners address friction upstream rather than requiring agents to absorb it downstream. In 1851, a New York bookkeeper named George D. Lyman observed the same absurd ritual each afternoon: porters carried bags of coins and bundles of checks bank to bank down Wall Street, settling by hand, a fortune exposed to error and theft. Lyman's fix: send everything through one central office and settle the net. On October 11, 1853, in the basement of 14 Wall Street, 52 banks cleared $22.6 million in a single sitting. Money between banks had stopped being an event and became seamless infrastructure.
 A century and a half later, the hard part is unchanged: moving money once is easy; making it work every time, for hundreds of thousands of businesses, across every rail, is hard. The bank account is where a company's financial life happens - payroll clears or it doesn't; a wire lands or a deal slips; the month closes clean, or someone loses a weekend to it. Mercury is building a business banking* product at a scale better than anything else in the market.
 Business Banking is the heart of Mercury. We're looking for a Head of Product to own it end-to-end: setting product strategy, leading a team of product managers, driving deposit and payment growth, and owning business performance.

Then Jobber might be the place for you! We're looking for a Product Marketing Manager, Operations to be part of our Product department.

The team:

Product Marketing sits within Jobber's Product organization, working alongside product teams to shape how our capabilities go to market and how customers adopt them. You'll join the Operations pillar, which covers the tools customers rely on every day to plan work, coordinate teams, connect the field and office, and understand how their business is performing. As these capabilities evolve, the team helps customers see how they fit together and why Jobber is worth their attention and investment.

The role:

Reporting to the Senior Manager, Product Marketing, the Product Marketing Manager, Operations will lead a defined Operations portfolio, owning positioning, go-to-market strategy and adoption from launch through ongoing learning. You'll start with the customer's business, workflows and challenges, then connect Jobber's capabilities into a clear story, from recognizing a need and choosing the right offering to realizing value through ongoing use. A big part of the challenge is reaching established and scaled businesses in a competitive market, many of which already use another solution, so we're looking for someone who brings creative, evidence-led recommendations on how to reach them, stand out and give them a compelling reason to switch. This is an individual contributor role, and you'll partner closely with your fellow Operations PMMs to connect your portfolio to the broader customer story and pricing and packaging strategy.

The Product Marketing Manager, Operations will:

 - Build a deep understanding of how owners, office teams and field crews plan and complete work, combining customer conversations, competitive insight, win/loss feedback and product data to uncover unmet needs, switching barriers and adoption opportunities.

 - Craft differentiated stories around the customer journey, making the value tangible through product demos, customer proof and clear messaging from discovery through ongoing use.

 - Shape the offer by bringing customer needs, willingness to pay and competitive context into packaging and commercial discussions, and help buyers and customer-facing teams find the right offering for each business.

 - Own the GTM plan for your portfolio with Product and the commercial lead, from target customer and proposition to route to market and success measures, and coordinate readiness with Sales, Enablement, Demand Generation and Lifecycle Marketing.

 - Improve discovery and adoption beyond launch, partnering with Product, Lifecycle Marketing, Education and Customer Success to help customers get started, realize value and build lasting habits.

 - Equip Sales and Success with competitive positioning, customer proof, demos and objection-handling guidance, then bring what you learn about buying barriers back to Product and commercial partners.

 - Keep the story consistent across campaigns, landing pages, product experiences and customer conversations, working with Demand Generation, Web and Lifecycle Marketing.

 - Connect your work to commercial outcomes such as conversion into the right offering, higher-tier attach and meaningful adoption, digging into funnel and cohort data yourself and partnering with Analytics on complex questions.

 - Use AI hands-on for research synthesis, analysis, GTM execution and repeatable workflows, verifying outputs and documenting what works so the whole team can reuse it.

To be successful, you should have:

 - A proven track record in product marketing for software products, including shaping strategy and positioning and owning initiatives through launch and post-launch learning.

 - Strong storytelling and writing skills: you can turn complex functionality into a clear customer benefit and present a recommendation to practitioners and senior stakeholders alike.

 - Sharp commercial judgment: you understand competitive alternatives and switching barriers, and can recommend how to reach an ICP, differentiate an offer and make practical investment trade-offs.

 - Analytical confidence: you can frame a business question, self-serve the data, interpret funnel and cohort evidence, and tell observed results apart from causal claims.

 - Hands-on experience using AI to improve research, GTM execution, analysis or team processes, and the ability to explain the impact and how you verified the work.

 - Experience with SMB software, vertical SaaS, field service or operational workflows is a bonus, and familiarity with home service businesses is helpful.

 - A track record of influencing Product, Sales, Customer Success and Marketing partners without direct authority, with clear ownership and dependable follow-through.

 - Comfort with evolving priorities: you bring recommendations and trade-offs, turn priorities into a practical plan, surface risks early and ask for support when decisions extend beyond your portfolio.

 - Genuine curiosity about how service businesses work, and a drive to learn directly from customers.

 - A collaborative approach that pairs a clear point of view with constructive feedback and respect for others' expertise.

Compensation:

At Jobber, we believe that compensation should be transparent, fair, and reflective of your experience and growth. This role has a minimum annual salary of $98,345, a midpoint of $115,700, and a maximum salary of $133,055, designed to show the progression from learning the ropes to truly excelling.

We design our compensation to reflect each new hire's skills, experience against the complexity of the role, ensuring a fair and competitive salary. Our range is intentionally broad to support growth and long-term impact, with fully established hires typically starting around the midpoint. The higher end of the range is reserved for those who have demonstrated deep expertise and lasting contributions, while offers below the midpoint reflect strong potential with room to develop. This approach ensures that compensation aligns with both an individual's current capabilities and their opportunity for future growth.

Base salary is just one part of a total compensation package that will include equity rewards, annual stipends for health and wellness, retirement savings matching, and an extended health package with fully paid premiums for body and mind. Your professional growth matters to us too! You'll have access to a dedicated talent development program that includes career coaching and opportunities for career development.

Who We Are

North Vector Dynamics is a Canadian-owned and controlled defence technology company specializing in precision interception, autonomy, and advanced propulsion. NVD is building a full-spectrum missile capability, from counter-UAS solutions to hypersonics, designed to serve and defend NATO member states and their allies and partners.

About the Role

North Vector Dynamics is building next-generation defence systems, and the CM70 is moving from prototype builds to a controlled, repeatable production line in a new Calgary manufacturing facility. We’re looking for a Manufacturing Engineer to design and build the tools, fixtures, equipment, and production methods that let us make our platforms faster, cheaper, and the same way every time.

Reporting to the Head of Manufacturing directly, you’ll join a small, hands-on team and own the hardware side of how we build: jigs and fixtures, gauging and inspection tooling, additive and machined parts, equipment selection and setup, and the design-for-manufacturability (DFM) loop with our Systems Engineering team. You’ll work closely with our Process Engineer, who owns routings, work instructions, and quality data, so that the process on paper and the tooling on the floor are designed together.

Your first big projects will be helping stand up our new manufacturing space, from layout and equipment moves to commissioning and re-validation, and turning prototype build know-how into production-ready tooling as the CM70 design baseline is frozen.

This is a ground-floor role for someone who is technically rigorous, happiest with their hands on the hardware, and energized by building from a clean sheet rather than inheriting a mature line. You’ll work side by side with our technicians and design engineers, along with senior leadership, and your work will define how North Vector Dynamics builds hardware as we scale.

If you want to build the machines that build platforms which will one day support soldiers in the field, save lives, and serve sovereign national interest - this role was written for you.

What You’ll Do

Tooling, Fixtures & Equipment

• Design, build, and validate assembly jigs, fixtures, gauges, and inspection tooling for the CM70 and future products, so every technician builds and checks the same way, every time.

• Specify, source, install, and commission production and test equipment, including additive manufacturing systems, machining, automation, wiring harness, and electronics assembly equipment as we bring more work in-house.

• Own our additive manufacturing capability: printer and material selection, print parameters and post-processing, part qualification, and the cost and shelf-life trade-offs that decide what we print versus buy.

• Set up calibration and maintenance plans for the tools and equipment you put on the floor, and keep tooling under identification and revision control.

• Lead tool control and point-of-use storage: tool check-in and check-out, shadow boards, and workstation layouts that support FOD and ESD control.

Design for Manufacturing & Production Support

• Partner with Systems Engineering on DFM and design-for-assembly reviews, BOM and CAD scrubs, tolerance stack-ups, and material and process choices, and feed what we learn on the floor back into the design.

• Support the move from prototype to production as the CM70 design is baselined: build readiness, pilot builds, first article inspections, and engineering change cut-ins.

• Be the first line of engineering support on the floor: solve build problems in real time, lead root cause analysis on equipment, tooling, and process failures, and drive corrective actions through to closure.

• Identify the constraints that limit how many units we can build per cycle (method, machine, material, and manpower) and engineer them out through better tooling, automation, and flow.

• Work with Supply Chain on make-versus-buy decisions, supplier technical questions, and qualification of machined, printed, and electronic parts from new and second-source suppliers.

New Facility & Continuous Improvement

• Help plan and execute the layout of our new manufacturing space: equipment placement, material flow, utilities, workstation design, and controlled areas for quarantine, calibrated tools, and controlled storage.

• Lead equipment moves, commissioning, and re-validation so production restarts at the new site with minimal downtime.

• Track cycle time, yield, scrap, and equipment uptime, and lead kaizen, 5S, and line-balancing efforts as volumes increase.

• Support our MES and ERP rollouts with tooling, equipment, and station data, and help build processes that meet AS9100 and Controlled Goods Program requirements.

• Step into whatever the mission demands: this is a startup, no two weeks will look the same!

What You Bring

Required

• A bachelor’s degree (minimum) in manufacturing, mechanical, mechatronics, industrial, or aerospace engineering, or an equivalent technical discipline from an accredited program and institution.

• 3+ years as a manufacturing, tooling, or production engineer in a hardware production environment, with a track record of fixtures, tooling, or equipment you designed and put into service.

• Strong CAD skills (Autodesk Inventor/Fusion, SolidWorks, or similar), working within a PDM environment, with the ability to take a fixture from concept to drawing to finished part.

• Ability to read, interpret, and create engineering drawings with GD&T, and to run tolerance stack-ups and basic engineering calculations.

• Hands-on experience with additive manufacturing (FDM, SLA, SLS, or similar) and with machined part design, including design for the process.

• Experience specifying, installing, and commissioning production equipment, and working with equipment vendors and integrators.

• Working knowledge of structured root cause analysis (8D, 5 Whys, fishbone) and lean manufacturing practices (standard work, 5S, kaizen) applied on a real shop floor.

• Comfort with data: tracking and presenting cycle time, yield, and equipment metrics in Excel, Power BI, or similar tools.

• Comfort working hands-on: building, adjusting, and troubleshooting tools and equipment yourself, not just designing them.

• Eligibility for a Government of Canada security clearance and registration under the Controlled Goods Program; active clearance is a significant asset.

• A builder’s mindset: you take ownership of the system, not just the task, and you’re as comfortable on the floor with a technician as you are in a design review.

Preferred

• P.Eng. or EIT designation, or eligibility for registration in Alberta or conversion from an eligible province.

• Prior experience in a UAS, aerospace, munitions, or defence manufacturing environment operating under AS9100 or a similar quality management system.

• Experience with industrial additive manufacturing systems and engineering materials, including part qualification for end-use parts.

• An electromechanical assembly background: wiring harnesses, PCB handling and ESD control, torque control, adhesives, or composites.

• Experience with automation, PLCs, or robotics, and with designing semi-automated assembly or test stations.

• Exposure to SMT/PCBA processes, or to energetics or explosives-safe manufacturing practices.

• Familiarity with first article inspection (AS9102), PFMEA, control plans, and measurement system analysis.

• Experience launching a new production line or facility, or ramping volume in a startup or scale-up.

• Lean Six Sigma Green Belt or higher.

Why North Vector Dynamics

• Real ownership from day one: the systems and processes you help build will be foundational to how this company operates for years to come.

• A tight-knit, high-caliber team that moves fast, holds each other to a high standard, and doesn’t waste time on bureaucracy for its own sake.

The Company You’ll Join
 Carta is the connected platform and AI-native ecosystem for private capital. Built to replace fragmented tools with a single system of record, Carta brings together the software, services, and legal infrastructure that founders use to manage equity, fund managers use to run administration and reporting, and legal teams use to close transactions. Trusted by 55,000 companies and 1.8M+ equity holders in 160+ countries, and 10,000 funds and SPVs representing $250B+ in assets under management, Carta is transforming how private capital operates. Recognized by Fortune, Forbes, Fast Company, Inc. and Great Places to Work.
 The Team You'll Work With 
 Every fund CFO’s office runs on spreadsheets, email threads, and a pile of portals that don’t talk to each other. We’re replacing all of it. Carta’s Investors business unit is building the system of record for private markets: the ledger, the books, the tax filings, the LP reporting, and the deal pipeline, all in one connected platform. Nearly 7,000 funds and SPVs and $150B in assets already run through it today.
 Here’s the fun part: we’re not building another portal. We’re building a programmable back office. An expense lands in an inbox and gets coded to the right entity and staged for approval. A capital call goes out from a sentence. A K-1 is ready on day one. The software does the work, and customers reach it through the AI tools they already use.
 It’s a pivotal moment for the business unit. The core is proven (90% of cash transactions reconciled in one day), and now we’re connecting it into a single platform that runs from fund financials to tax to LP reporting. You’ll join small, senior teams that blend startup-style speed with the rigor of software that moves real money.
 We’re hiring multiple engineers, and you’ll be hired into the Investors business unit as a whole, then matched to a focus area based on your strengths and interests during our interview process. These focus areas include:
 Fund Financials: Ledger, expense allocation, and cash reconciliation. Get the numbers right, automatically, at scale.
 Tax and Compliance: K-1s, KYC, and audit trails. Compliance as code instead of compliance as a checklist.
 LP Management and Reporting: Capital calls, distributions, PCAPs, and tearsheets. Turn quarterly reporting from a scramble into a query.
 The Problems You'll Solve 
 As a Staff Engineer, you are responsible for the long-term technical health and success of the Investors business unit. You’ll work to:
 Navigate Ambiguity: Tackle the most complex and poorly defined problems at Carta, breaking them down into navigable paths for the rest of the organization.
 Champion Systemic Improvement: Identify and eliminate failure patterns across multiple systems, driving architectural changes that improve scalability and reliability.
 Bridge Technical Gaps: Use your deep understanding of cross-functional domains to align multiple teams on major technical decisions.
 Define the AI Frontier: Lead the charge in transforming how we build by defining the context and building the rails that allow every person at Carta to leverage AI tools safely and effectively. You’ll help move the organization toward a future where AI amplifies our collective engineering impact.
 Uphold Engineering Standards: Set the vision for operational excellence and mentor senior engineers to raise the collective craft of the organization.
 About You 
 The Tech Stack: You are an expert in building distributed systems. While our primary stack is Python/Django, React, and Postgres, you should be comfortable guiding technical direction across JVM languages, gRPC, and cloud-native infrastructure (AWS). 
 Leadership: You lead through influence rather than authority, acting as a role model for constructive communication and technical discipline.
 Vision: You don't just solve the problem in front of you; you anticipate future roadblocks and build systems that support long-term business growth.
 Experience: We recommend 10+ years of professional software engineering experience with a track record of high-level technical leadership.
 Salary 
 Carta’s compensation package includes a market competitive salary, equity for all full time roles, exceptional benefits, and, for applicable roles, commissions plans. Our minimum cash compensation (salary + commission if applicable) range for this role is:
 $205,600 CAD - $257,000 CAD in Toronto, Ontario, Canada and Waterloo, Ontario, Canada
 Final offers may vary from the amount listed based on geography, candidate experience and expertise, and other factors.

An overview of this role
 As a Senior or Staff Backend Engineer with the Database Excellence group , you'll build and evolve database automation and PostgreSQL as a service capabilities for GitLab. The level will be determined during the hiring process. You'll use Go to automate the full lifecycle of PostgreSQL across GitLab's infrastructure, making database operations safer, more consistent, and easier to scale for databases that sit behind high-throughput, always-on internet services. You'll work closely with partner teams to shape how GitLab provisions and manages PostgreSQL in a fully remote, highly collaborative environment.
 Some examples of our projects:
 SQL Traffic Replay Tooling , which validates upgrades and changes against real production workloads.
 PostgreSQL as a Service Platform , which provides standardized, automated provisioning and lifecycle management for internal product databases.
 PostgreSQL Major Version Upgrade Automation , which supports safe, repeatable major upgrades at GitLab.com scale.
 What you’ll do
 Design, build, and maintain Go-based automation that manages the full PostgreSQL lifecycle, including provisioning, configuration, upgrades, failover, scaling, and decommissioning, reducing reactive operational work that currently takes more than 80% of the team's time.
 Build automation that works across infrastructure-as-code tooling and cloud infrastructure, and evaluate operator-based approaches as the platform evolves.
 Use AI agents as a regular part of building and operating services, including implementation, review, and reducing repetitive work, while keeping the context agents need in the repository so the whole team can build on it.
 Build for internet scale by designing automation and services for high-throughput, always-on production workloads, where GitLab.com traffic sets the bar for correctness, latency, and availability.
 Integrate compute, storage, networking, identity and access management, and managed data services across cloud providers into one coherent PostgreSQL platform instead of creating bespoke setups for each database.
 Build GitLab's PostgreSQL as a service platform to replace bespoke database setups with standardized, automated provisioning and lifecycle management, so supporting more databases doesn't require growing the operations team at the same rate.
 Collaborate closely with product management, infrastructure, software delivery, and other engineering teams to design and ship high-performing solutions.
 Research, design, and implement improvements to PostgreSQL performance, scalability, and data health, helping maintain more than 8 months of operational runway for all critical database saturation points.
 Review database automation and Go changes from other engineers and contributors, with attention to safety, maintainability, and performance.
 Document automation practices, PostgreSQL operational patterns, and guidance that helps engineers use and contribute to the platform.
 Build safe, repeatable automation for PostgreSQL major version upgrades at GitLab.com scale, validating changes against real production traffic before rollout.
 Operate what you build in production from end to end, using production feedback to guide each iteration.
 Take part in on-call or operational support where your team’s ownership model requires it.
 What you’ll bring
 Professional software engineering experience working with PostgreSQL in large, complex production environments, including experience building or operating a database-as-a-service product.
 Proficiency with Go, including designing, implementing, testing, and reviewing backend services.
 Experience developing Kubernetes operators, controllers, or similar automation for the lifecycle of stateful services, especially databases. Kubernetes experience is one way to demonstrate this skill, but isn't required; comparable experience building database or infrastructure automation is welcome.
 Comfort with infrastructure as code and core database operations concepts such as high availability, replication, backups, and system-level performance trade-offs.
 Familiarity with Ruby is a plus but isn't required. Much of GitLab's application codebase uses Ruby on Rails, and being able to read it helps when designing automation that application teams depend on. We’ll expect you to become comfortable with it on the job, not on day one.
 Strong written communication skills and comfort working asynchronously in an all-remote, distributed team.
 Self-directed work style with effective organizational skills, the ability to manage priorities as a "manager of one," and alignment with GitLab's values of transparency, collaboration, inclusion, and open source contribution, as well as its operating principles .
 Ownership of the technical direction for a major initiative such as the PostgreSQL as a service platform, turning an ambiguous problem into an architecture and a sequenced plan that several engineers can execute in parallel.
 Influence beyond the team, setting the patterns other engineers follow, partnering with sibling database, infrastructure, and platform teams, and growing engineers through design reviews and mentorship.
 About the team
 The Database Excellence group keeps GitLab’s databases running reliably through proactive health management, operational excellence, and strategic enablement. We maintain operational runway by identifying and addressing saturation points, operate infrastructure through automated and scalable processes, and provide tools and frameworks that help teams build features sustainably. Our primary focus is GitLab.com, and we're expanding our scope to provide database health frameworks and tooling that benefit self-managed customers as well.

The base salary range does not include any bonuses, equity, or benefits. See more information on our benefits and equity . Sales roles are also eligible for incentive pay targeted at up to 100% of the offered base salary.

Vous serez le spécialiste de l'intégration pour la technologie opérationnelle (TO) : la personne qui montre aux équipes d'usine et d'installations comment MaintainX se connecte aux systèmes qui font fonctionner leurs machines, notamment grâce à nos connecteurs de données TO pour Ignition, Kepware et MQTT, ainsi qu'à notre solution de surveillance sans fil des vibrations. Si les données d'équipement d'un client potentiel se trouvent dans une couche SCADA ou dans un système d'archivage de données (historian), c'est vous que l'équipe de vente appellera.

Le poste

Vous serez responsable du volet technique de chaque vente où les machines, les capteurs et les systèmes de contrôle d'un client doivent se connecter à MaintainX.

 - Mener la découverte TO auprès des équipes d'exploitation et d'automatisation, puis associer leurs sources de données au bon connecteur afin que la portée soit claire avant la conclusion de la vente.

Vous travaillerez quotidiennement avec les directeurs de comptes, les architectes de solutions, les équipes de mise en œuvre, le Produit et la R&D, et vous assurerez l'encadrement des vendeurs quant au moment opportun de faire appel à vous. Après six mois, vous serez la première personne jointe pour toute discussion TO. À propos du rôle

L'ingénieur(e) en déploiement avancé s'intègre aux équipes des partenaires de Hopper, dont certaines des plus grandes banques, compagnies aériennes et entreprises de voyage au monde. Il ou elle y déploie notre IA de bout en bout : obtenir les données, bâtir et ajuster les modèles, puis les mettre en production. Vous dirigerez le volet données et modélisation sur place, au sein d'une petite équipe de déploiement avancé, et ferez le pont entre les partenaires et l'équipe de recherche. Ce qui distingue ce rôle, c'est que les données importantes se trouvent dans les systèmes mêmes des partenaires. Vous les rendez donc utilisables, de façon sécuritaire, et vous transformez chaque déploiement en outils réutilisables qui accélèrent le suivant.

À quoi ressemblerait votre quotidien

 - Travailler sur place avec les équipes des partenaires pour vous connecter à leurs systèmes, y compris les plateformes sur site et les systèmes hérités, et bâtir des flux de données sécuritaires et fiables.

 - Faire correspondre des données commerciales désordonnées et incohérentes, provenant de multiples sources, à un modèle unique et propre.

 - Concevoir et exploiter des pipelines pour de grands ensembles de données historiques et quasi temps réel, avec surveillance et contrôles de la qualité des données.

 - Répondre aux exigences des partenaires en matière de sécurité, de protection des renseignements personnels et de révision par les TI, en ne recueillant que les données nécessaires au produit.

 - Concevoir, entraîner et évaluer des modèles d'apprentissage automatique de production pour un cas d'usage commercial à haut volume, en choisissant la bonne approche et en expliquant clairement les compromis.

 - Mettre en place les mécanismes d'évaluation et de mesure qui montrent si les modèles sont suffisamment bons, et où ils ne le sont pas.

 - Bâtir des services à faible latence et à haut débit qui servent les modèles en production.

 - Concevoir la manière dont le système décide quoi répondre et comment, et comment il s'améliore grâce à l'usage réel.

 - Assumer la responsabilité de la fiabilité, des coûts et de la performance une fois le système en service.

 - Collaborer directement avec les équipes technologiques et d'affaires, des premières discussions jusqu'à la mise en service.

 - Travailler avec les équipes de recherche et de produit, en leur transmettant ce que vous apprenez sur le terrain.

 - Transformer chaque déploiement en outils réutilisables pour que le prochain partenaire aille plus vite.

Le ou la candidat(e) idéal(e) possède

 - 5 ans et plus d'expérience à bâtir et à livrer des systèmes d'apprentissage automatique de production de bout en bout, couvrant les données, la modélisation, le service des modèles et la surveillance. Vous appliquerez cette expérience à un cas d'usage commercial à haut volume dès le premier jour.

 - Une solide expérience en ingénierie des données, avec la conception et le maintien en exploitation de pipelines sur de grands ensembles de données désordonnés. Vous vous en servirez pour transformer les données des partenaires en un modèle unique et propre.

 - De l'expérience en intégration avec des systèmes que vous ne contrôlez pas, comme des plateformes d'entreprise, sur site ou héritées. Vous avez aussi traversé le processus de révision de sécurité et de TI d'un client, ce qui vous permettra de faire circuler les données des partenaires de façon sécuritaire.

 - De l'expérience dans la conception et l'exploitation de services qui traitent des milliers de requêtes par seconde avec des temps de réponse inférieurs à la seconde. Vous vous en servirez pour servir les modèles en production.

 - De l'expérience dans l'industrie du voyage (compagnies aériennes, hôtels, agences de voyage en ligne, métamoteurs de recherche ou technologies de voyage), avec les disponibilités, les tarifs, les horaires et les inventaires. Vous connaissez aussi les systèmes qui les sous-tendent, comme les GDS, le NDC et les systèmes de réservation des compagnies aériennes et des hôtels, afin de lire rapidement les données des partenaires et de repérer ce qui compte.

 - Un bon jugement sur les compromis de modélisation et la capacité de les expliquer à des partenaires non techniques. Vous vous en servirez pour guider les équipes des partenaires dans leurs décisions, des premières discussions jusqu'à la mise en service.

 - Au moins deux déploiements réalisés en immersion chez un client d'entreprise, au sein de ses systèmes, de ses contrôles de données et de ses révisions de sécurité, de sorte que vous êtes prêt(e) à diriger le volet données et modélisation sur place.

 - La disponibilité pour voyager et passer plusieurs semaines d'affilée sur place avec les équipes des partenaires.

Atouts

 - Expérience à la fois dans les données aériennes et hôtelières, ou dans un autre marché à haut volume (commerce électronique, publicité numérique, technofinance) en plus du voyage, afin d'apporter à chaque déploiement des approches issues d'autres secteurs.

 - Expérience avec des modèles de prévision, d'estimation ou de recommandation en production, et expérience de travail aux côtés d'une équipe de recherche pour transformer ses méthodes en résultats chez un client.

 - Expérience en déploiement avancé, en ingénierie de solutions ou en ingénierie d'intégration dans une entreprise de logiciels ou de données d'entreprise, ou diplôme d'études supérieures en informatique, en statistique ou dans un domaine connexe.

Avantages et conditions de travail

 - Entreprise en démarrage bien financée et éprouvée, aux grandes ambitions, avec salaire concurrentiel et possibilité de gains grâce à des régimes d'actions préalables au premier appel public à l'épargne (PAPE)

 - Hopper paie 100 % des primes du régime d'assurance collective

 - Hopper offre une assurance vie ainsi qu'une assurance invalidité de courte et de longue durée

 - Compte de gestion santé (CGS) couvrant les dépenses médicales et dentaires admissibles

 - Tous les employés et les personnes à leur charge ont accès aux services de télémédecine de Dialogue, en tout temps et de partout

 - Tous les employés ont accès à un REER avec retenues automatiques avant impôt à chaque paie

 - Renseignez-vous sur notre généreux congé parental, bien supérieur aux normes de l'industrie!

 - Congés payés illimités

 - Allocation voyage Carrot Cash

 - Accès à un espace de cotravail sur demande grâce à FlexDesk, ET allocation pour le télétravail

 - Culture entrepreneuriale où repousser les limites et prendre des risques font partie du quotidien

 - Communication ouverte avec la direction et les dirigeants de l'entreprise

 - Équipes petites et dynamiques = impact énorme

À propos de Hopper

Chez Hopper, nous bâtissons la plateforme de technologie de voyage de premier plan au monde, et nous le faisons en réglant de vrais problèmes pour de vrais voyageurs partout dans le monde. Nos plateformes de réservation grand public Hopper et HTS (Hopper Technology Solutions), notre volet interentreprises (B2B), travaillent de concert pour offrir aux voyageurs ce que l'industrie n'a jamais pu leur offrir de façon fiable : transparence, flexibilité et véritables économies à chaque voyage. Nous combinons d'énormes quantités de données et d'IA à des produits technofinanciers exclusifs pour y arriver. Nous ne sommes pas un simple moteur de réservation, mais une façon fondamentalement meilleure de planifier et de vivre le voyage, pour nos clients comme pour nos partenaires. Nous sommes la preuve qu'il est possible de faire mieux pour le client et pour l'entreprise à la fois.

Et notre croissance se poursuit à un rythme rapide! L'application Hopper a été téléchargée plus de 120 millions de fois, et 70 % de nos utilisateurs font partie de la génération Z et des milléniaux, les voyageurs de la prochaine génération. Aujourd'hui, notre plus grande occasion est d'alimenter la technofinance, le commerce et la fidélisation du voyage pour certaines des plus grandes marques de l'industrie. Notre premier partenariat HTS, avec Capital One, a permis de lancer un portail de voyage dédié aux titulaires de cartes d'une grande marque financière. Depuis, nous nous sommes étendus à certains des plus grands noms du voyage et de la banque, dont Air Canada, Uber, la Banque Royale du Canada (RBC) et Nubank, en propulsant tout, d'une simple intégration technofinancière jusqu'à un portail de fidélisation de voyage complet de bout en bout.

Voilà notre trajectoire : nous avons commencé comme une petite application avant-gardiste dans l'univers du voyage, et nous sommes maintenant le moteur qui fait tourner la technologie du voyage.

Concrètement, voici ce que cela donne :

 - Des milliards de dollars en voyages et en technofinance transitent chaque année par Hopper et HTS.

 - Nos produits technofinanciers, dont Annulation pour n'importe quelle raison (Cancel for Any Reason) et Aide en cas de perturbation pour n'importe quelle raison (Disruption Assistance for Any Reason), obtiennent une satisfaction client exceptionnelle, parce que les conditions sont claires et que le règlement est instantané, sans poser de questions.

 - Près de 30 % des clients de l'application ajoutent un produit technofinancier à leur réservation, et ces clients sont 1,6 fois plus susceptibles de réserver de nouveau chez nous.

 - HTS génère maintenant plus de 90 % des activités, ce qui démontre la rapidité avec laquelle le B2B a pris de l'ampleur.

 - Grâce à HTS, tout fournisseur de services de voyage (compagnies aériennes, hôtels, banques, agences de voyages) peut brancher les solutions technofinancières, commerciales et d'IA de l'entreprise à ses propres canaux, qu'il s'agisse d'une seule intégration ou d'un portail de voyage complet de bout en bout.

ABOUT THE ROLE

The Forward Deployed Engineer embeds with Hopper's partners, some of the world's largest banks, airlines and travel companies, to bring our AI into their business end to end: getting the data, building and tuning the models, and taking them to production. You will lead data and modelling on site as part of a small forward-deployed team, acting as the bridge between partners and Research. What makes the role distinctive is that the data that matters lives inside partners' own systems, so you make it usable, securely, and turn each deployment into reusable tooling that makes the next partner faster.

 - Work on site with partner teams to connect to their systems, including on-premise and legacy platforms, and build secure, reliable data feeds.

 - Map messy, inconsistent commercial data from many sources into one clean model.

 - Build and run pipelines for large historical and near-real-time datasets, with monitoring and data quality checks.

 - Meet partners' security, privacy and IT review requirements, taking only the data the product needs.

 - Design, train and evaluate production ML models for a high-volume commercial use case, choosing the right approach and being clear about the trade-offs.

 - Build the evaluation and measurement that show whether the models are good enough, and where they aren't.

 - Build low-latency, high-throughput services that serve the models in production.

 - Design how the system decides what to answer and how, and how it improves from real usage.

 - Own reliability, cost and performance once the system is live.

 - Partner directly with technology and business teams, from first conversations to go-live.

 - Collaborate with Research and Product, feeding back what you learn in the field.

 - Turn each deployment into reusable tooling so the next partner goes faster.

AN IDEAL CANDIDATE HAS

 - 5+ years building and shipping production ML systems end to end, covering data, modelling, serving and monitoring, which you will apply to a high-volume commercial use case from day one.

 - Strong data engineering experience, having built and kept running pipelines over large, messy datasets, which you will use to turn partner data into one clean model.

 - Experience integrating with systems you don't control, such as enterprise, on-premise or legacy platforms, and working through a customer's security and IT review, so you can get partner data flowing securely.

 - Experience building and running services that handle thousands of requests per second at sub-second response times, which you will use to serve models in production.

 - Travel industry experience (airlines, hotels, OTAs, metasearch or travel technology) working with availability, rates, schedules and inventory, and the systems behind them such as GDS, NDC and airline and hotel reservation systems, so you can read partner data quickly and spot what matters.

 - Sound judgment on modelling trade-offs and the ability to explain them to non-technical partners, which you will use to guide partner teams through decisions from first conversations to go-live.

 - At least two deployments embedded with an enterprise customer, working inside their systems, data controls and security reviews, so you are ready to lead data and modelling on site.

 - Willingness to travel and spend multi-week stretches on site with partner teams.

 - Bonus: experience in both airline and hotel data, or in another high-volume marketplace (e-commerce, ad tech, fintech) as well as travel, to bring patterns from other verticals to each deployment.

 - Bonus: forecasting, estimation or recommendation models in production, and experience working alongside a research team to turn their methods into results at a customer.

 - Bonus: forward-deployed, solutions or integration engineering experience at an enterprise software or data company, or an advanced degree in computer science, statistics or a related field.

Mindrift connects specialists with project-based AI opportunities for leading tech companies, focused on testing, evaluating, and improving AI systems. Participation is project-based and is not an employment relationship.
 What this opportunity involves 
 We're looking for contributors to share their own medical lab report. You add the original files, and details that identify you, such as names, ID numbers, dates of birth, and contact details, are covered automatically and checked again during review before the report is used. You also check the redacted preview before you submit. The lab's name and address, the test names, and the results stay in the report. Once your report is accepted, it is no longer linked to you. The files help improve AI systems that read and understand medical documents. In this project, contributors may:
 Add the PDF file of their own lab report, for example blood test results;
 Take an iPhone photo of each printed page of the report and a screenshot of each page on an iPhone, iPad, or Mac;
 Check the redacted preview of each page and submit it only if all details that identify them are covered;
 Add one report per task;
 Submit clear files where every page of the report is fully visible.
 If you have your own lab test results and are comfortable sharing them once your personal details are covered, apply to take part in this project.
 What we look for 
 This opportunity is a good fit for people who have their own lab test results and are open to a short-term, project-based collaboration. To take part, contributors will need:
 To be 18 to 65 years old and live in one of these countries: the UK, Canada, Ireland, Germany, Switzerland, Poland, Portugal, Brazil, Spain, Türkiye, Norway, Indonesia, the UAE, or Israel (no VPN while using Mindrift);
 Their own medical lab report as a PDF file (1 to 10 pages): lab test results only, such as a blood count, blood chemistry, or a urine test;
 A report from a lab in the country where they live, preferably in the local language (reports in English, or in both languages, are also accepted);
 A printed copy of the report, an iPhone (any model) for the photos, and an iPhone, iPad, or Mac for the screenshots.
 This opportunity is not suitable for someone else’s lab report (for example, a family member’s), a translated or edited copy of a report, or other medical documents such as discharge summaries or surgery notes. 
 How it works  
 Apply → Get an email from Mindrift Team (check spam too) → Register on Mindrift → Verify your identity → Sign the project consent form → Add your report's PDF, photos, and screenshots and check the redacted preview → Get paid for each accepted report 
 Privacy
 Taking part is voluntary, and choosing not to take part doesn’t affect your Mindrift account. Before your first task, you read and sign a project consent form. Details that identify you, such as names, ID numbers, dates of birth, addresses, phone numbers, and email addresses, as well as doctors' names and signatures, are covered automatically and checked again during review before the report is used. Your original files are deleted. Once your report is accepted, it is no longer linked to you. We never ask you to send your report by email, chat or anywhere outside the Mindrift platform.
 Project time expectations 
 Each lab report is a separate task, and you can add reports whenever it suits you while the project is active. This is a time-limited project, and the number of reports we can accept is not guaranteed. Reports need to meet the listed criteria to be accepted. If a report needs a fix, it comes back to you with the reason. 
 Earnings  
 Paid per accepted report:  $10 for every lab report  (PDF, photos, and screenshots of each page) that passes our quality checks. Earnings are added to your Mindrift balance once the report is accepted. 
 You can withdraw them to your bank account or PayPal via Tipalti, or via Payoneer (minimum $20). Payouts are processed twice a month. Mindrift doesn't deduct any fees, but your payment provider may charge a small transfer fee.

[https://app.ashbyhq.com/api/images/user-content/4ea5f68e-c33e-4ac9-831a-e732bee4a303/8f9d2fd6-1fd4-49d9-81a2-b66850fd33fd/image.png]
 

ABOUT THIS ROLE

You will help us win Enterprise accounts in Pacific and Mountain time zones by managing the full sales cycle from pipeline generation through to won. You can expect to own a curated list of excellent fit, high propensity accounts as well as a geographic territory with significant market opportunity.

In this role, you'll primarily focus on new logo acquisition via a healthy mix of inbound and outbound, while also covering a small number of customer accounts for expansion and upsell. Our emphasis is on your ability to excel in the areas listed below and your appetite for continuous growth & improvement.

 

ROLE REQUIREMENTS:

 - You have a multi-year track record of exceeding $1M+ quotas, selling complex SaaS technologies to large organizations

 - You have closed many $100K+ ARR sales which require consensus building and executive engagement.

 - You have a demonstrated ability to win highly competitive opportunities by identifying pain and business impacts and connecting those to strategic initiatives of the leadership team

 - You are a hunter at heart and are comfortable self-sourcing a majority of your own pipeline

 - You have a growth mindset and are excited to tackle the challenges of a high growth startup

 

YOU COULD BE A GREAT FIT IF:

 - 📣 You demonstrate mastery of clear communication. You ask questions with precision and can explain complex concepts in simple terms. You eschew business jargon.

 - 🏔️ You skillfully guide prospects through their entire buying process—engaging the right stakeholders at the right time to create consensus for a strategic technology decision.

 - 🤓 You become both a product and industry expert. You create ‘Ah ha!’ moments in collaboration with your Solutions Engineer to build momentum & solve customer-specific challenges.

 - 🔍 Your peers describe you as detail oriented. You send timely & crisp follow-up emails. You take pride in internal operations, like real-time CRM updates.

 - 🤝 You have strong business acumen. You help customers connect the dots between technical problems and their business impact. You craft compelling cases for change.

 - 💰 You're excited to land the biggest deals we've ever done. You are diligent and gritty and have demonstrated perseverance to win long, competitive sales cycles.

 - ⚙️ You're a creative problem solver and comfortable with some healthy ambiguity. You'll help us refine our Enterprise go-to-market motion to maximize the segment's results over time.

 - ✈️ You're willing to travel for company events, customer meet ups and on-sites. 

 

YOU MAY NOT BE A GREAT FIT IF:

 - 🤫 You dislike prospecting. Enterprise reps at Ashby are responsible for sourcing half or more of their pipeline to complement our robust inbound lead flow.

 - 💻 You prefer to leave demos "to the experts." While you can expect Solutions Engineering support, our most successful AEs are those with strong curiosity and deep product acumen.

 - 💼 You're more of a relationship builder who focuses on selling into the install base. This is primarily a new business oriented role.

 - 🐺 You're a lone wolf. You prefer to go it alone in your pursuit of new business. We believe in a team-selling sales model.

BONUS:

 - Familiarity with Talent Acquisition and HR tools and workflows

 - A network that includes Heads of Talent whom you can tap into
   
    

INTERVIEW PROCESS

Our interview process is thorough — we assess if you are the right fit for Ashby and we will provide ample information for you to determine if Ashby is the right place for you. The process for this role is as follows:

 - Intro Call (30 min) - You'll meet with a Recruiter to discuss your fit for the role and address questions about our market and solution.

 - Written Exercise -  You'll complete a short take home assignment to showcase your outbound muscle. 

 - Experience Deep Dive (60 min) - You'll walk the Hiring Manager through your career journey in some detail to highlight your experience, achievements, and points of learning to understand how you've developed into the professional you are today.

 - Challenge Interview (90 min) - This will be made up of two parts: 
   
   - Discovery and Demo Role Play (60 min) 
   
   - Deal Strategy Discussion (30 min) 

 

BENEFITS

 - Unlimited PTO with four weeks recommended per year

 - $100/month education budget with more expensive items (like conferences) covered with manager approval.

 - If you’re in the US, top-notch health insurance for you and your dependents with 100% of all premiums covered by us, Flexible Spending Accounts and 401K match. We also offer up to 12 weeks of fully paid family/parental leave for all caregivers.

We're in the talent acquisition software business. We run the end-to-end hiring process through our own platform, and ensure a level playing field for all candidates. Reaching out to hiring managers or recruiters directly won't improve your odds of success. Please focus your energy on the quality of your application.
